anomalies.description: Two men engage in a mutual physical fight inside a wooden pen, with one delivering a kick and the other blocking or countering; spectators surround them.
A second distinct fighting sequence occurs: one man throws a punch at another’s face while others watch closely; motion blur indicates rapid movement and impact.

Two men engage in a bare-knuckle fistfight in front of a crowd; the long-haired man in white and the shirtless bald man exchange punches, with visible impact and motion blur indicating forceful strikes.
Two men engage in a mutual, intense hand-to-hand fight inside a fenced enclosure, with rapid punches and defensive movements observed across multiple frames.

A shirtless man repeatedly strikes a restrained victim with a wooden object (likely a stick or club) while the victim is held by others; the victim is visibly in distress and unable to defend himself.; After the fight, the man in the white shirt is restrained by two others while visibly distressed and screaming; his posture and facial expression indicate he is being held against his will in a non-consensual manner.
The restrained victim is being forcibly held by two men while the aggressor continues to assault him; the victim screams in pain, indicating ongoing physical abuse.
The shirtless man performs a high kick toward the restrained victim, captured mid-air; this appears to be part of the same abusive sequence but involves dynamic combat motion.
The victim remains restrained and screaming in extreme pain, with visible facial contortion and open mouth, while the aggressor stands nearby; the context confirms continued abuse.

Two men engage in a physical fight: one in a white shirt executes a high kick toward a shirtless opponent, who is positioned to receive the strike; onlookers hold sticks and animal skulls, suggesting a staged or ritualized combat.

A shirtless man is shown with blood streaming from his mouth, appearing injured and helpless while being held or restrained by others; no active combat visible, suggesting post-assault abuse or intimidation.

A physical struggle occurs where the man in the white t-shirt (from earlier frames) is seen grabbing and pulling another person's arm, with visible tension and forceful contact; his facial expression shows exertion and aggression.
